figurative_meaning_en: in reproach: an excessively clever or cunning boy
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা চালুছেলে, সবসময় চালাকি করে লোককে ধোঁকা দিতে চায়।
আমার ভাইয়ের বন্ধু চালুছেলে বলে সবাই এড়িয়ে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a sly boy, always trying to trick people with his cleverness.
My brother's friend is a smart aleck, so everyone avoids him.
note: This idiom is often used in colloquial Bengali to denote slyness in a derogatory manner, reflecting everyday social interactions.
